title: minuartia groenlandica subsp. glabra
intro: Minuartia groenlandica subsp. glabra, commonly known as Greenland Winter-cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Greenland Winter-cress include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall health. Bioactive constituents of Greenland Winter-cress include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
